name: pyre_zombie
description: a Pyre Zombie (Fall from Heaven), a hulking hunched burning corpse: charred dark-brown skin split by glowing orange lava cracks, flames rising from its shoulders and the top of its small head, one glowing orange eye and a gaping fiery mouth, a ragged purple loincloth tied with a frayed rope belt, a grey iron chain hanging at its screen-left hip, bare clawed feet, and no weapon: it attacks with the burning clawed LEFT hand (screen-right)
hands: its weapon is its burning clawed left hand on the screen-right side, hanging open with the claws curled; its right hand on the screen-left side is an empty clawed hand hanging at its side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the burning clawed left hand is lifted up over the head, its claws pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and hunched, the burning clawed hand cocked behind the head, the other clawed hand tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps forward over the head and the burning clawed left hand reaches high out in front to the right, above head height, claws first, about to rake down toward the lower-right
strike.4: contact: the clawed left arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the burning claws raking down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the other clawed hand swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the burning clawed hand carries on down toward the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the flames on its head and shoulders trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the burning clawed hand swings back toward its hanging ready pose

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, its glowing eye squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty clawed right hand flung out to the left, the burning clawed left arm flung out to the right), the flames on its shoulders flaring
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the burning clawed hand dipping, the other clawed hand still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the burning clawed arm flung up, the other arm drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the clawed hands lowering, the flames on its shoulders shrinking
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the burning clawed hand resting on the ground, the other arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the arms go limp and the iron chain slips off its hip, legs slide forward, its flames guttering
death.5: hits the ground: lying on its back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, clawed hands empty; the grey iron chain lies loose on the ground at the lower-right; the purple loincloth spread under it
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, a few sparks fly up
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on its back, the lava cracks dimmed to a dull red glow, only a few small flames left, the iron chain on the ground beside it
